description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android TV app, responsible for displaying detailed content information such as title, synopsis, images, and action buttons. It includes intent extra definitions, UI setup, focus management, and handling of back navigation with focus restoration.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An activity displaying detailed information about a content item including title, synopsis, image, tags, and runtime, with focus handling and sharing intent construction.

methods.name: buildIntent
methods.description: Constructs an intent to launch ContentInfoActivity with provided content details and focus restore indices.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, populates data from intent extras, and sets focus navigation.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events, specifically intercepting the back button to restore focus state.

methods.name: deliverFocusRestoreResult
methods.description: Prepares and sets the result data including row and item indices for focus restoration when activity finishes.
